rapport_notes: Genuinely sympathetic to the customer's bad prior-mover experience and reassuring throughout.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Not asked directly, but customer volunteered the concern unprompted: 'I had a really bad experience with my last movers.'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep said 'Oh no. Tell me about it' then only 'Got it, okay' — one layer, no 'what else worries you' follow-up.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: None of the five lines used — no damage-coverage/$2,000 mention despite the customer's damage anxiety being the whole reason for the call.

top_strength: Led with genuine empathy for a customer burned by a previous mover, which built real trust.
coaching_note: This customer explicitly raised damage fear — a perfect setup for the Sheet 1 'we move it like it's ours / up to $2,000 coverage' line, and it was never used.
